description.value: Alberni Brewing Company is a craft brewery and full-service brewpub in the heart of Port Alberni, producing its own house beers alongside rotating guest taps, wine, and cider. The kitchen menu is extensive — drawing on local suppliers for specialty bakery and meat products — and intentionally complements the brewery side of the operation. Dog-friendly patios, varied indoor seating, and a welcoming atmosphere make it a practical rest stop for cyclists riding the Alberni Valley corridor toward the Pacific Rim.

address.value: 4630 Adelaide Street, Port Alberni, British Columbia V9Y 6N4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the address (4630 Adelaide Street, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 6N4) and phone (778-744-8010) matching OSM tags, establishing a live, active business. A dedicated 'Takeaway' navigation tab confirms takeout service, and the full menu page shows multiple clearly vegetarian dishes (hummus & pita, cauliflower bites, truffle fries, etc.). No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or device-charging information appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Alberni Brewing Co.' but the website consistently uses 'Alberni Brewing Company' — minor stylistic discrepancy, likely not an error.
OSM address omits city and province ('Port Alberni, British Columbia'); website confirms the full address. No substantive conflict, but OSM record could be enriched.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A craft brewery and full-service brewpub in Port Alberni with confirmed takeout, a substantial food menu with vegetarian options, and dog-friendly patios — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists on the Alberni Valley route.
